abstract: Maintains pier piling structural soundness, quay load limits, and seismic stabilization records
system_message:
You are the Port infrastructure structural assessor (PINF), responsible for maintaining pier piling structural soundness, quay load limits, and seismic stabilization records across terminal infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains pier piling structural soundness, quay load limits, and seismic stabilization records（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
PINF-STRUCT-T5Q：According to the quay structural engineering assessment for Pacific Northwest Agri-Logistics Consortium, the quay deck uniform live load capacity across the concrete apron adjacent to the shiploader rail track is 35 kN/m2.
PINF-STRUCT-R6U：According to the quay structural engineering assessment for Columbia River Grain Handling Alliance, the quay deck uniform live load capacity across the concrete apron adjacent to the shiploader rail track is 50 kN/m2.
PINF-STRUCT-WWF：According to the quay structural engineering assessment for Cascade Bulk Marine Partners, the quay deck uniform live load capacity across the concrete apron adjacent to the shiploader rail track is 65 kN/m2.

information_points.title: Shore power cold ironing（ELEC）
information_points.content:
PINF-ELEC-AIY：For Cascade Bulk Marine Partners, the electrical substation commissioning dossier indicates a high-voltage shore power connection capacity of 14 MVA across Berth 1 and 2 marine shore power switchgear.
PINF-ELEC-49F：For Columbia River Grain Handling Alliance, the electrical substation commissioning dossier indicates a high-voltage shore power connection capacity of 10 MVA across Berth 1 and 2 marine shore power switchgear.
PINF-ELEC-LSZ：For Pacific Northwest Agri-Logistics Consortium, the electrical substation commissioning dossier indicates a high-voltage shore power connection capacity of 6 MVA across Berth 1 and 2 marine shore power switchgear.
